title: WorkPulse employee.transferred v1
description: A new employment period started. History is append-only: the previous period closes and this event names the department transition (position/location/manager changes ride along).

employee_id.description: Employee the event refers to (UUIDv7 string).

to_department_id.description: Department the new period starts in (UUIDv7 string).

effective_from.description: First day of the new employment period (YYYY-MM-DD); periods are half-open [effective_from, effective_to).

to_position_id.description: Position of the new employment period (UUIDv7 string). Optional (ADR 0019): pre-extension stored envelopes lack it; null/absent means the projection keeps the previous value.

to_location_id.description: Location of the new employment period (UUIDv7 string). Optional (ADR 0019): pre-extension stored envelopes lack it; null/absent means the projection keeps the previous value.
